title: From Data Scarcity to Data Care: Reimagining Language Technologies for Serbian and other Low-Resource Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative ethnographic approach using semi-structured interviews with NLP scholars and practitioners to examine structural inequalities, the ethnocentric Western lens of source data, and the limitations of cross-lingual transfer, supplemented by anecdotal prompting of commercial models.

Expert interviews and qualitative analysis of corpus creation practices to evaluate how reliance on low-quality web-scraped data and historical textual destruction reinforce existing social imbalances (e.g., missing dialects, gender disparities, and excluded demographics).
